name: Acceptance suite-2 test 48 boundary - Principal '*' + aws:PrincipalArn CONDITION wildcard is valid
note: IAM-903 boundary: a wildcard in an aws:PrincipalArn CONDITION value is the VALID construct AWS documents for pattern-matching principals (unlike a wildcard in the Principal element itself). Principal '*' + ArnLike aws:PrincipalArn must stay an ordinary public-trust finding (TRUST-PUBLIC) and must NOT be flagged TRUST-INVALID-PRINCIPAL. This is the exact pattern the invalid-principal remediation recommends.
